subject: [internal] ACH wire confirmation needed — invoice INV-3382 ($6,475)
body:
Hey team,

Quick question on SOP governance — which SOP do we follow for handling vendor onboarding requests right now? I see SOP-12 and REF-04 both mention it and I want to make sure I'm pointing the new ops hire at the right one.

Thanks,
Tim

expected_outcome.notes: EDGE CASE — hybrid email: ACH/payment language in the subject, SOP-governance meta-question in the body. Found live on 2026-06-11 when the same email classified differently across two runs (Finance/ACH escalate vs meta-question draft). classify_email Rule 1 was patched to explicitly override Rule 2: money language anywhere in the email forces Finance / ACH / Owner Approval, deterministically. Mixed signals involving money must NEVER resolve to the softer reading.
